title: ALTA/NSPS land title surveys: the 2026 standards apply
rule: The 2026 Minimum Standard Detail Requirements for ALTA/NSPS Land Title Surveys, an industry standard adopted jointly by ALTA and NSPS rather than a statute, took effect February 23, 2026 and replaced the 2021 edition. A survey contracted on or after that date follows the 2026 standards, with very limited exceptions. The request names a 2026 ALTA/NSPS Land Title Survey and the optional Table A items wanted. Where a state's minimum standards are stricter, the surveyor meets those too.

citation.authority: Minimum Standard Detail Requirements for ALTA/NSPS Land Title Surveys (2026), American Land Title Association and National Society of Professional Surveyors

changeWatch: The next joint ALTA/NSPS revision; the standards are revised about every five years.

sources.title: ALTA/NSPS Land Title Survey Standards
sources.quote: The updated standards go into effect February 23, 2026, and will replace the 2021 version as of that date.

sources.title: 2026 ALTA/NSPS Standards
sources.quote: Contracts signed on or after February 23, 2026: The survey must be done to the 2026 ALTA/NSPS Standards, with only very limited exceptions.
